question: Where is TIC Wireless located?
answer: We're at 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057 — in the shopping center on Hillcroft near Windswept, just north of the Westpark Tollway. Call (713) 339-9300 if you need directions.

question: What is your address?
answer: 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057.

question: What is your phone number?
answer: You can call us at (713) 339-9300.

question: Did you move? I went to 3838 Hillcroft.
answer: Yes — we moved from 3838 Hillcroft St, Suite 100, to our new, bigger store at 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057. Same team, same phone number. Some map apps may still show the old address.

question: Is there parking?
answer: Yes, there's a parking lot in front of the store in the shopping center, including wheelchair-accessible parking.

question: Is the store wheelchair accessible?
answer: Yes. We have a wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking.

question: Do you have a website or social media?
answer: Our website is https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app (Spanish: https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app/es). You can also find us on Facebook at facebook.com/ticwireless and on TikTok at @tic.wireless.

question: What are your hours?
answer: We're open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

question: Are you open on Sunday?
answer: Yes, Sundays from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

question: Are you open today / right now?
answer: Our hours are Monday–Saturday 9 AM–8 PM and Sunday 9 AM–5 PM. Holiday hours can vary, so call (713) 339-9300 if you want to double-check.

question: Do I need an appointment?
answer: No appointment needed — just walk in during store hours, including for repairs.

question: Can I get a phone with bad credit or no credit?
answer: Yes! We offer financing and lease-to-own on unlocked iPhones and Android phones with no credit needed — bad credit is OK. Options start at $40 down, subject to approval. Stop by with a valid photo ID or call (713) 339-9300.

question: How much is the down payment?
answer: Options start at $40 down. The exact amount depends on the item and the plan you're approved for.

question: What do I need to apply for financing?
answer: Bring a valid photo ID to the store. The application takes just a few minutes at the counter, and our team will let you know if anything else is needed.

question: Is approval guaranteed?
answer: Approval isn't guaranteed, but no credit is needed and bad credit is OK. It only takes a few minutes in store to find out. Call (713) 339-9300 with any questions.

question: What is lease-to-own?
answer: Lease-to-own isn't a loan: you lease the item and make regular payments, and once the plan is complete (or you buy it out early) it's yours. The total cost can be more than the cash price, and we explain all terms in store before you sign.

question: Can I pay off my financing early?
answer: Yes, ask us about early-payoff options when you apply — paying it off sooner can lower your total cost.

question: Can I finance a PS5, Xbox or Nintendo Switch?
answer: Yes. We offer lease-to-own on game consoles like PlayStation 5, Xbox and Nintendo Switch 2 — no credit needed, options from $40 down, subject to approval. Call (713) 339-9300 to check what's in stock.

question: Can I finance a laptop, MacBook or iPad?
answer: Yes. Laptops (including MacBook Air), iPads and tablets are available with lease-to-own, no credit needed. Call (713) 339-9300 to check stock.

question: Do you have the new iPhone?
answer: Yes, we carry the latest unlocked iPhones, including iPhone 17 Pro, with financing available. Stock changes often, so call (713) 339-9300 to confirm the model, color and storage you want.

question: Do you sell Samsung phones?
answer: Yes — we carry unlocked Samsung Galaxy phones and other Androids, with financing available. Call (713) 339-9300 to check current models.

question: Do you buy or trade in used phones?
answer: Yes. You can trade in your old phone toward a new one or sell it. Bring it in and we'll take a look.

question: Which carriers do you have prepaid plans for?
answer: We offer prepaid plans from Verizon Prepaid, AT&T Prepaid, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, Cricket, Boost Mobile, Simple Mobile, Lyca Mobile, GoSmart and Gen Mobile. No contracts.

question: How much are your prepaid plans?
answer: Plan prices depend on the carrier and change often. Call (713) 339-9300 or stop by and we'll find the best plan for you.

question: Can I pay my phone bill at your store?
answer: Yes. We take in-person bill payments for the major prepaid carriers, with no extra charges.

question: Do you sell home internet?
answer: Yes, we sell Xfinity Prepaid home internet and set it up for you in store.

question: Do you do international recharges?
answer: Yes. We do international mobile top-ups, including Tigo, Digicel, Movistar and Telcel, and more.

question: Do you fix cracked screens?
answer: Yes. We repair screens on iPhone, Samsung and other Android phones. Most screen repairs are done the same day. Call (713) 339-9300 for a quote for your model.

question: How much does a screen repair cost?
answer: It depends on your exact phone model. Call (713) 339-9300 with your model, or stop by — we'll give you the price before any work starts.

question: How long does a repair take?
answer: Most phone screen, battery and charging-port repairs are finished the same day. We'll give you a time estimate before we start.

question: What kinds of repairs do you do?
answer: Phones, tablets, laptops and computers — cracked screens, batteries, charging ports and software problems.

question: My phone won't charge. Can you fix it?
answer: Yes, we repair charging ports and batteries. Bring it in (no appointment needed) and we'll check it in front of you and quote the price first. Questions? Call (713) 339-9300.

question: Can you replace my battery?
answer: Yes. We replace batteries on iPhone, Samsung and other Android phones, usually the same day.

question: Do you repair laptops and tablets?
answer: Yes, we repair tablets, laptops and computers too. Call (713) 339-9300 to describe the problem or bring it in.

question: Can you unlock my phone?
answer: Yes, we unlock phones so you can use them with the carrier you choose. Bring your phone in and we'll check it.

question: Do you sell phone cases?
answer: Yes — we have a huge case wall with cases for most iPhone and Samsung Galaxy models: clear, color, rugged, MagSafe and ring-stand styles, including brands like OtterBox and ZIZO.

question: Do you sell screen protectors?
answer: Yes, we carry tempered glass and UV glass screen protectors for most models.

question: Do you have AirPods?
answer: Yes, we carry Apple AirPods, including AirPods Pro, plus AirPods Max. Call (713) 339-9300 to check current stock.

question: Do you sell Galaxy Buds or other earbuds?
answer: Yes — Samsung Galaxy Buds, JBL earbuds and more.

question: Do you sell JBL speakers?
answer: Yes, we carry JBL speakers like the Charge, Flip, Clip and Go, plus Soundcore speakers.

question: Do you sell smartwatches?
answer: Yes — Samsung Galaxy Watch, Fitbit and other smartwatches, plus bands.

question: Do you sell chargers and cables?
answer: Yes: wall chargers, car chargers and mounts, charging cables and wireless charging stations.

question: Is a specific item in stock?
answer: Stock changes often. Please call (713) 339-9300 and we'll check for you — we can also set it aside.

question: Can I buy online?
answer: You can browse our accessories at https://lime-hillcroft-hub.lovable.app/shop. Online checkout is launching soon — for now, call (713) 339-9300 or visit the store to buy.

question: Do you speak Spanish?
answer: Yes! Se habla español. Our team helps customers in English and Spanish, in store and on the phone.

question: What are your reviews like?
answer: We're rated 4.7 out of 5 on Google from more than 400 reviews.

question: Can I talk to a person?
answer: Of course — call us at (713) 339-9300 during store hours (Mon–Sat 9 AM–8 PM, Sun 9 AM–5 PM), or visit us at 3640 Hillcroft St.

question: ¿Dónde están ubicados?
answer: Estamos en 3640 Hillcroft St, Houston, TX 77057, en el centro comercial sobre Hillcroft cerca de Windswept, justo al norte del Westpark Tollway. Llámanos al (713) 339-9300 si necesitas indicaciones.

question: ¿Cuál es su horario?

question: ¿Cuánto es el enganche?
answer: Las opciones empiezan desde $40 de enganche. La cantidad exacta depende del equipo y del plan que te aprueben.

question: ¿Tienen PS5, Xbox o laptops a pagos?
answer: Sí. Consolas (PlayStation 5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2), laptops, MacBook y iPad con opción a compra, sin necesidad de crédito. Llama al (713) 339-9300 para revisar inventario.

question: ¿Reparan pantallas?
answer: Sí. Reparamos pantallas de iPhone, Samsung y otros Android; la mayoría quedan el mismo día. Llama al (713) 339-9300 para cotizar tu modelo.

question: ¿Cuánto cuesta cambiar la pantalla?
answer: Depende del modelo de tu celular. Llama al (713) 339-9300 o ven a la tienda; te damos el precio antes de empezar.

question: ¿Liberan celulares?
answer: Sí, liberamos celulares para que los uses con la compañía que quieras. Tráelo y lo revisamos.

question: ¿Puedo pagar mi factura de teléfono ahí?
answer: Sí. Recibimos pagos de las principales compañías prepagadas, sin cargos extra.

question: ¿Qué compañías prepagadas tienen?
answer: Verizon Prepaid, AT&T Prepaid, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, Cricket, Boost Mobile, Simple Mobile, Lyca Mobile, GoSmart y Gen Mobile.
